dct_description_sm: Afghanistan administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 34 Province - Admin 2: 401 District Note: Admin 2 notes: although the de-facto authority in Afghanistan have designated 457 admin 2 units, the humanitarian community is using 401 units due to lack of boundary data for 2026 Dates associated with this dataset: - 01 June 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 June 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 25 March 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 May 2019: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Afghanistan](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-afghanistan). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Afghanistan Geodesy and Cartography Head Office (AGCHO), National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA)
